snippet.title: AROMA LOVE READY!Demo is now available on steam and is free to play!
snippet.description:
A fantastic, lively and super-sweet otome game is here! "AROMA LOVE READY!" Demo is now available on steam and is free to play!
# Enjoy love in a light-hearted comedy atmosphere~ Don't worry about what can be left for tomorrow! 
# With 230,000 words (Chinese) of text and full voice acting coverage~ We're full of sincerity, all for your romantic experience! 
# Three male protagonists + eighteen different endings~ There's always something you'll like. Take a look before you go! Come on, just move your little finger and add it to your wishlist! Looking forward to meeting you~ (starry eyes)
Game Development: Fuqi Manman Studio
Game Publishing: Wise Games
Voice Actor for Jing Tang: Simmon
Voice Actor for Lu Sihua: Yulin Feng
Voice Actor for Luo Fei: Chu Qiu
PV Production: Fufu/Mengmeng/Lili
Composer and Arranger of PV Promotion Song "AROMA LOVE": Lei Bro
